answer: Use a refundable bond for each agent that wants to review jobs. Picture a quartz supplier sending a shipment on a long voyage: before dispatch, the ledger randomly picks reviewers who have already locked a bond. Each commits a verdict before seeing others, so a private whisper cannot tell them which verdict to copy. A review proven fraudulent costs its bond. An attacker running forty identities must lock forty separate bonds, even if the lottery picks only one of them.
